Definition: from G40; sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality):--holiness.
BiblicalUsage: hagiōsýnē is the word for holiness. In Romans 1:4, the text says "according to the spirit of holiness." In 2 Corinthians 7:1, the text says "perfecting holiness in the fear of God."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hagiōsýnē is a reminder that purity is not prudishness; it is keeping ourselves for the God who made us. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
